description: Explore published birdwatching tours from the BirdWatch catalogue. Search by destination, target birds, tour style, duration, dates and budget; read available itineraries and tour details; and follow BirdWatch links to make an inquiry. Prices, availability and wildlife sightings require confirmation. BirdWatch does not book trips or send inquiries through this integration.

defaultPrompt: Find three birdwatching tours in Costa Rica and compare their duration.
Which tours target the Resplendent Quetzal? Show BirdWatch links.
Read the itinerary and inclusions for a tour I select.
